assets.codeHint: Printed on labels. Cannot be reused, even after retirement.

meters.empty: This asset has no meters yet.
meters.isReset: Meter was replaced or rolled over (allows a lower value)

kindHint.Cumulative: A running total that only goes up, such as energy or run hours.
kindHint.Gauge: A value that moves both ways, such as temperature.

meters.name: Name

documents.fileHint: PDF, image, Word, Excel or text. Up to 25 MB.
documents.title: Files

label.reissueWarning: A new code replaces the current one. Labels already printed with the old code will stop working.

import.allOrNothing: Nothing is saved unless every row is valid.

hint.assets: Columns: code, name, nameAr, classCode, locationCode, parentAssetCode, criticality, status, manufacturer, model, serialNumber, installDate, warrantyExpiry. Classes and locations must already exist.

import.intro: Create many locations or assets from a spreadsheet saved as CSV.
import.problems: {{count}} rows have problems. Nothing was saved.
import.title: Import
import.wouldCreate: The file is valid. {{count}} rows will be created.

setup.title: Setup
setup.classesHint: Categories such as HVAC, Electrical or Lifts. Every asset belongs to one.
setup.noClasses: No asset classes yet. Create one before adding assets.
setup.fieldsHint: Extra information to capture on locations or assets. Keys and types cannot be changed once created.
setup.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and '_', starting with a letter.

scan.title: Scan asset label
scan.notFound: No asset matches this label. It may have been replaced or belong to another organisation.

users.title: Users and roles
users.intro: People who have signed in, and what they are allowed to do. A new person has no role until you give them one.
users.deactivateWarning: They are signed out of everything on their next action and cannot use the system until reactivated. Their history and roles are kept.
users.reactivateInfo: They regain the access their roles give them.
users.deactivatedHelp: Ask your administrator to reactivate it.

workAction.ApprovedHelp: Approve this request so it can be assigned.
workAction.VerifiedHelp: Confirm the work was done properly. This cannot be the person who did it.
workAction.ClosedHelp: Close the work order. It becomes read-only.

work.titleHint: A few words: what is wrong?
work.findAssetHint: Type at least two letters of its code or name, or scan its label.
work.priorityHint: Leave as default unless it is more or less urgent.
work.settingsLegend: Steps every work order goes through
work.requireApproval: Requests need approval before they are assigned.
work.requireApprovalHint: Emergencies are never held for approval.
work.requireVerification: Finished work is checked by someone other than the person who did it.
work.requireVerificationHint: Turn off only if you accept that people sign off their own work.
work.requireSignature: Work cannot be completed without the technician’s signature.
work.requireSignatureHint: Signing needs a pen, finger or mouse.
work.labourRateHint: Applied to time as it is recorded; earlier entries keep the rate they had. Zero means labour is not costed.

repeat.title: Assets with repeat problems ({{count}})
repeat.help: Three or more repair requests in the last 90 days. Counted from the work orders, not guessed.

sla.intro: Service levels set how quickly requests must be answered and finished. Time counts only during working hours, and stops while work is on hold.
sla.noCalendars: No calendars. Without one, every hour of every day counts.
sla.sitesHint: A site follows one calendar. Sites with none follow the default.
sla.makeDefault: Use for sites that have no calendar of their own
sla.noPolicies: No policies yet, so no clocks run.
sla.policiesHint: The default policy covers everything; a category policy replaces it for that category.
sla.targetsHint: In working minutes, counted from approval.
sla.appliesLater: Changes apply to requests approved from now on. Clocks that are already running keep their deadlines.

sla.ResolutionAtRisk: {{number}} is close to missing its resolution time

permit.approved: Permit PTW-{{number}} is ready to issue

evidence.noChecklist: No checklist on this work order.
evidence.fileHint: A photo from the camera, or a PDF, Word, Excel or text file. Up to 15 MB.
evidence.padLabel: Signature area: draw with a finger, pen or mouse
evidence.templatesHint: Reusable lists to add to a work order. A work order keeps its own copy, so later edits do not change work already planned.

offline.offline: Offline: your work is saved on this phone
offline.signInToSend: Sign in to send your work
offline.limited: Only your saved jobs are available until you are back online and sign in again.
offline.signOutWarning: {{count}} change(s) have not reached the server yet. Signing out deletes them from this phone. Sign out anyway?

jobs.title: My jobs
jobs.neverDownloaded: No jobs are saved on this phone yet. Open this page once while online.
jobs.none: No open jobs are assigned to you.
jobs.notFound: This job is not saved on this phone.
jobs.blockedChecklist: Answer every required checklist line first.
jobs.blockedSignature: The technician’s signature is required first.
jobs.failedNeedsNote: A failed line needs a note.

pm.title: Preventive maintenance
pm.intro: Recurring maintenance planned in advance. Work orders are created automatically ahead of each due date.
pm.noForecast: Nothing is planned in this period.
pm.truncated: Too many items to show; narrow the period or filter by asset class.
pm.templatesHint: A template says what the work is: instructions, priority, and a checklist. Schedules use it to create work orders.
pm.findAssetHint: Type at least 2 letters of its name or code.
pm.leadHint: The work order appears this many days before it is due.

basisHint.Fixed: Fixed dates: the next one is due on the calendar, even if the last one was late.
basisHint.Floating: From completion: the next one is due after the last one is finished.
basisHint.None: Meter only: no calendar dates; due when the meter reaches the interval.

pm.meterHint: Also create work when a meter reading has advanced by an amount since the last service. Whichever comes first applies.
pm.assignHint: Leave empty to put the work in the approved queue for dispatch.

kpi.intro: Planned visits by their due date. A visit counts as on time when it was finished on or before its due date. Visits not yet due are shown separately and are not counted against anyone.
kpi.plannedNote: {{planned}} planned and {{other}} other work orders raised in this period (cancelled ones are left out).
kpi.none: No planned visits fall in this period.

pm.partsHint: Reserved from stock when each visit's work order is created. If a part is short, the visit is still created and the shortage is recorded.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.intro: Spare parts and consumables: what is in each store, what is held for work orders, and what is running low.
inventory.noStock: No stock yet. Receive some to get started.
inventory.unitCostHint: What one unit cost; the store's average cost follows.
inventory.referenceHint: A delivery note or invoice number.
inventory.adjustHint: Direct corrections need a reason and are recorded for audit. For a full recount use a stock take.
inventory.reorderHint: When the available quantity falls to the minimum, the people who look after stock are told once.
inventory.codeHint: 1–50 letters, digits, dot, dash or slash.
inventory.unitHint: How it is counted: pcs, litre, m…
inventory.takesHint: Count a store. A different person approves the count before any stock changes.
inventory.startTakeHint: The system quantities are frozen when you start. Enter what you find.
inventory.addFound: Found something not on the sheet
inventory.findItemHint: Type at least 2 letters of its code, name or barcode.

parts.intro: Parts are held for the job by a planner, then taken from stock by the technician. Unused parts can be returned.
parts.closed: This work order no longer takes parts.
parts.none: No parts reserved or used yet.
parts.releaseWarning: Let go of the {{quantity}} {{unit}} held for this work order?

vendors.title: Vendors and contracts
vendors.intro: The companies that do work for you, and the contracts that say what they must do and when.
vendors.statusHint: A vendor on hold or blocked cannot be given new work or orders. Existing work carries on.
vendors.renewalNoticeHint: The people who manage vendors are told once.
vendors.saveFirst: Save the contract first, then add what it covers, its service targets and its files.
vendors.coverageAll: No coverage listed: the contract is treated as covering everything.
vendors.coverageHint: A work order is covered when its asset, the asset's class, or its site is listed.
vendors.slaHint: What the vendor promises for each priority, in minutes. Shown on work orders given to the vendor under this contract; they are not enforced as clocks.
vendors.notCovered: This contract does not list this site, asset or class
vendors.contractTargets: Contract targets: respond within {{response}} min, resolve within {{resolution}} min
vendors.contractOptional: Optional. Only contracts in force are listed.

purchasing.title: Purchasing
purchasing.intro: Ask for what you need, get it approved at the right level, order it from a vendor and receive it into stock.
purchasing.stockItem: A stock item (goes into a store when it arrives)
purchasing.agreedPricesHint: Change a price if the vendor quoted differently. The order may exceed the approved total only by the allowed tolerance.
purchasing.limitsHint: A request is approved at the level its total needs. Each approval level includes the ones below it, and nobody approves their own request.
purchasing.level1Hint: Up to this total, a first-level approver is enough.
purchasing.level2Hint: Up to this total a second-level approver is enough; above it, a third-level one is needed.
purchasing.toleranceHint: How far above the approved total an order may go.

integration.title: Accounting connection
integration.intro: Vendors, purchase orders and goods received are sent to your accounting system as they change. Nothing is ever written to its database directly.
integration.sendToErp: Send changes to the accounting system
integration.adapterHint: The connector that knows how to talk to your accounting system.
integration.companyHint: For example the legal entity code, such as USMF in Dynamics 365 Finance.
integration.readOnly: Only an administrator can change the connection.
integration.nothingSent: Nothing has been sent yet. Changes are sent once the connection is on.

portal.title: Vendor portal
portal.intro: Orders, jobs and contracts shared with {{vendor}}.
portal.noWork: No jobs have been given to you.

accept.title: Join the vendor portal
accept.missing: This page needs the link from your invitation email. Open that link again.
accept.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and open the invitation link again.
accept.done: You now have access. Your orders, jobs and contracts are waiting.

vendorPortal.title: Portal access for {{vendor}}
vendorPortal.intro: Invite the vendor’s people. Each person sees only this vendor’s orders, jobs and contracts.
vendorPortal.email: Email of the person to invite
vendorPortal.linkHelp: Copy this link and send it to {{email}} yourself. It is shown only now and cannot be shown again.

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.intro: Floor plans, what each space holds, who it is given to, and how full a place is.
spaces.chooseFloor: Choose a floor to see its plan.
spaces.planHint: A PNG, JPEG or WebP picture, up to 10 MB. Pins stay where they are.
spaces.noPlan: This floor has no plan yet.
spaces.clickPlan: Click the plan to move the selected pin.
spaces.capacityHint: How many people it holds. Nothing can be allocated while this is 0.
spaces.untilHint: Leave empty for until further notice.
spaces.withoutCapacity: {{count}} space(s) have no capacity set and are left out of the totals.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.intro: Book rooms, desks, parking and equipment, and see what is taken.
bookings.chooseResource: Choose what you want to book.
bookings.needsApproval: Bookings need approval before they are confirmed.
bookings.repeatHint: 1 books this day only. More books the same time every week; if any week is taken nothing is booked.
bookings.requested: Requested ({{count}}). You will be told when it is decided.
bookings.viewOnly: You can see what is free but not book.
bookings.feedHelp: Follow your bookings in your calendar app. It only reads them; nothing you do there changes a booking.
bookings.feedNew: Make a new address (the old one stops working)
bookings.feedOnce: Copy this address into your calendar app now. It is shown only this once.
bookings.notYourOwn: Someone else must decide your own request
bookings.zoneHint: A name like Asia/Riyadh. Opening hours are in this zone.
bookings.advance: Book at most this many days ahead
bookings.grace: Minutes allowed to check in after the start
bookings.syncHelp: Send bookings to a company calendar as they are made, changed or cancelled.
bookings.syncNone: No calendar connection is available on this server yet.

visitPass.title: Visitor pass
visitPass.invalid: This pass is not valid. Ask your host for a new one.
visitPass.qrAlt: QR code for your visitor pass

visitors.title: Visitors
visitors.intro: Expect visitors, welcome them at the front desk and see them off.
visitors.emailHint: Optional. Kept for the retention period, then removed.
visitors.untilHint: Optional. Leave empty for the day.
visitors.onBehalfHint: Reception can expect a visitor for someone else.
visitors.passHelp: Send this address to your visitor, or let them scan the code. They show it at reception.
visitors.passOnce: This is shown only now. If it is lost, make a new pass (the old one stops working).
visitors.scan: Scan or type the pass code
visitors.scanHint: A scanner types it for you. The address on the pass also works.
visitors.lookupFailed: That pass could not be found.
visitors.noneToday: Nobody is expected on this day.
visitors.badgeHint: Optional: the number of the badge you hand over.
visitors.inductionAck: The visitor has read and accepted the induction
visitors.overrideReason: Why may this visitor come in?
visitors.overrideHint: Security only. This is recorded with your name.
visitors.watchlistHelp: People who must not be let in without security's say. A visitor whose name matches (ignoring accents, spacing and spelling variants) is stopped at the desk, and only security can let them in, with a reason.
visitors.removeReason: Why is this person being removed?
visitors.requireInduction: Contractors must accept the site induction at check-in
visitors.retentionHint: After this, names and contact details are removed; the visit record stays.
visitors.blocked: This visitor cannot be checked in. Please call security.

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: Figures from every area you may see, for a period and optionally one site.
reports.nothing: There is nothing here you are allowed to see.
reports.failed: These figures could not be worked out just now.
reports.notBySite: These figures are not kept by site, so they cover everything.
reports.feedIntro: Let Power BI or Excel read your data directly. The feed is read-only, shows only ids, dates, amounts and statuses (no names or free text), and each access token can be revoked at any time.
reports.feedStep1: Make an access token below and copy its secret (it is shown only once).
reports.feedStep2: In Power BI or Excel choose Get data, then OData feed, and paste the address.
reports.feedStep3: When asked to sign in, choose Basic: any user name, and the secret as the password.
reports.feedNameHint: The tool or person it is for, so you can tell tokens apart.
reports.feedSecretHelp: Copy it now. It cannot be shown again; if lost, revoke the token and make a new one.

workflow.title: Work order workflow
workflow.intro: Choose which optional steps and evidence your organisation uses. Every change is a new version with who, when and why, and the earlier rules stay readable.
workflow.defaults: No changes published yet; the standard rules apply.
workflow.requireApproval: Work orders need approval before work starts
workflow.requireApprovalHint: Turn off to let everything start straight away.
workflow.requireVerification: Completed work is checked by someone other than the worker
workflow.requireVerificationHint: The checker can never be the person who did the work.
workflow.noteHint: Shown in the history and the audit trail.
workflow.fixedHint: These protect the integrity of the record and cannot be switched off.

fixed.noSelfApproval: Nobody can approve their own request.
fixed.verifierIsNotTheWorker: Whoever verifies work is never the person who did it.
fixed.checklistBeforeCompletion: Required checklist items must be done before completion.
fixed.closureCodeAndNotes: Closing needs a closure code and notes.
fixed.emergenciesSkipApproval: Emergencies start immediately, without waiting for approval.
fixed.closedIsLocked: A closed work order cannot be changed.
fixed.reasonsForHoldRejectReopenCancel: Hold, reject, reopen and cancel always need a reason.
fixed.everyChangeAudited: Every change is recorded in the audit trail.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.intro: A record of who did what and when. It can be searched and exported but never edited.

admin.title: Administration
admin.intro: Everything you can manage for your organisation.
admin.none: You do not have access to any administration area.
admin.usersHint: Invite people and decide what they can do.
admin.setupHint: Asset classes, custom fields, categories and checklists.
admin.feedHint: Read-only access for BI tools, with revocable tokens.
admin.auditHint: Search and export the record of changes.
admin.aiHint: Switch suggestions on or off, set the daily limit, see use.

license.title: License
license.intro: What this installation is licensed for.
license.readOnly: The license does not allow changes right now. Data can still be read.
license.moduleClosed: This area is not included in the license.
license.userLimit: The license allows no more active users. Ask an administrator to deactivate someone or raise the license.

banner.Grace: The license has ended. Everything keeps working until {{date}}; renew it before then.
banner.Expired: The license has ended. Data can be read but not changed until it is renewed.
banner.NotYetValid: The license is not valid yet. Data can be read but not changed.
banner.Invalid: The license file is not valid. Data can be read but not changed.
banner.Missing: No license is installed. Data can be read but not changed.
banner.WrongInstallation: The license was issued for a different installation. Data can be read but not changed.

license.renewHelp: Replace the license file on the server (or update the secret it is mounted from). It is picked up within a minute, without a restart.

compliance.title: Compliance and permits
compliance.intro: Statutory inspections and certificates with their due dates, and permits to work for dangerous jobs.
compliance.firstDueHint: Until the first record is made.
compliance.ownerHint: Gets the warnings. Without one, the compliance managers do.
compliance.validUntilHint: Leave empty to use {{months}} months from the date done.
compliance.validUntilOneOff: Leave empty if it does not expire.
compliance.attach: Attach a certificate to the record of {{date}}
compliance.confirmPrecautions: Confirm each precaution is in place
compliance.isolationHint: The lock-out or isolation that makes the work safe.
compliance.areaSafe: The work is finished or stopped and the area is safe
compliance.typesIntro: Each kind of permit has a longest duration, precautions the issuer must confirm, and optionally an isolation reference and exclusive use of the place.
compliance.exclusiveHint: No other permit may be in force in the same place at the same time.
compliance.isolationRequiredHint: The permit cannot be issued without an isolation reference.

energy.title: Energy and utilities
energy.intro: Electricity, water and gas meters: readings by hand, from a file or from data loggers, with use, cost and alarms.
energy.overviewHint: Use is worked out from the readings between two moments. A reading lower than the one before is counted as a reset and left out.
energy.name: Name
energy.cumulativeHint: The reading is the total so far. Leave off when each reading is the amount used in its period.
energy.rolloverHint: Only if the register wraps around, for example 100000.
energy.importHelp: One reading per row with the columns meter, at, value (and optionally note). The first row names the columns. Check it first: nothing is saved until you import.
energy.tariffsIntro: The price of one unit from a date. The newest price that has started applies to each day. A day with no price has use but no cost.
energy.alarmsIntro: Rules that watch a meter. When one is raised, the people who manage energy are told.

alarmKindName.NoReading: No reading for a long time

energy.devicesIntro: Data loggers post readings with a secret of their own, limited to the meters you choose. The secret is shown once; it can be revoked at any time.
energy.secretOnce: Copy the secret for {{name}} now. It cannot be shown again.
energy.ingestHelp: Post to {{path}} with the header Authorization: Bearer <secret>. Body: { "readings": [ { "meter": "code", "at": "2027-03-01T08:00:00Z", "value": 1234.5 } ] }, at most 500 at a time.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Fit-outs, refurbishments and moves: a plan, a budget, and the work orders and purchase orders charged to it.
projects.name: Name
projects.linksIntro: Link a work order or purchase order by its number to charge it to this project. Spent counts completed work and received goods; committed counts what is ordered but not yet delivered.

leases.title: Leases
leases.intro: Premises you rent or let out: the term, the notice dates that must not be missed, and the rent schedule.
leases.counterpartyHint: The landlord when you rent; the occupier when you let out.
leases.noticeHint: How many days before the end notice must be given. 0 if none.
leases.alertLeadDays: Warn me this many days ahead
leases.alertHint: Managers are warned this long before each date.
leases.renewalHint: Leave empty if there is no option.
leases.locked: Dates and rent are fixed once the lease is active. Extend or terminate it instead.
leases.baseRentHint: The first period, before any rise.
leases.expiredNotice: This lease has run out. Extend it or terminate it.
leases.scheduleNote: This is what the lease terms say is due. Invoices, payments and accounting are not handled here.

ai.title: AI assistance
ai.intro: Optional suggestions for people to read and decide on. AI never changes anything by itself.
ai.notSetUpHelp: Whoever runs this installation has not connected an AI service, so AI cannot be turned on. Nothing is sent anywhere.
ai.enable: Turn AI suggestions on for my organisation
ai.enableTriage: Suggest a category and priority when a request is written
ai.enableSummary: Offer a summary of a work order
ai.dailyLimitHint: The most suggestions the whole organisation can ask for in a day (0 to 5000).
ai.whatIsSentText: Only the words of the request or work order being looked at, with e-mail addresses, web addresses and long numbers removed. No names of people, no attachments, no other records. The words are not kept by this product; only the number of calls and tokens is recorded. Your organisation’s data is not used to train a model by this product.
ai.triageTitle: AI suggestion for category and priority
ai.suggestHint: Uses the title and details above.
ai.checkIt: Written by AI. Check it before you rely on it.
ai.summaryTitle: AI summary of this work order
